description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Water)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Master of Water (0~2), removed after using Master of Water two times

description.name: Master of Water Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Master of Water level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Water)]

description.name: Master of Water Level
description.text: Keeps track of Master of Water level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Bartz (Water)]
